title: A New Standard in Railroad Rockfall Protection - A Progressive Railroading DemoCast
summary: On September 8, 2026, Will Becker, Product Manager - Obstacle Detection Systems, presented L.B. Foster’s Advanced Rockfall Monitoring system during a progressive Railroading DemoCast.
body_markdown:
The session, " *A New Standard in Railroad Rockfall Protection* ", explored the limitations of mechanical slide fences and demonstrated how[Rockfall Monitoring](https://lbfoster.com/rail/total-track-monitoring/rockfall-monitoring) is transforming rail safety through:


-


Real-world examples of Rockfall Monitoring in action


-


Advanced LiDAR technology that enhances operational confidence


-


Improved train velocity in challenging terrain


-


Reduced disruptions compared to traditional slide fences
